description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS driver emulating Battery-Backed RAM (BBRAM). Implements functions for setting and checking BBRAM status, reading, writing, and device initialization.

methods.name: bbram_emul_set_invalid
methods.description: Sets the invalid state of the emulated BBRAM.

methods.name: bbram_emul_set_standby_power_state
methods.description: Sets the standby power failure state.

methods.name: bbram_emul_check_invalid
methods.description: Checks and clears the invalid state, returning previous value.

methods.name: bbram_emul_check_standby_power
methods.description: Checks and clears standby power failure state.

methods.name: bbram_emul_check_power
methods.description: Checks and clears power failure state.

methods.name: bbram_emul_get_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the emulated BBRAM.

methods.name: bbram_emul_read
methods.description: Reads data from emulated BBRAM at specified offset.

methods.name: bbram_emul_write
methods.description: Writes data to emulated BBRAM at specified offset.
